newsitem.title: USA: Republican Craig re-elected in Idaho Senate race.
newsitem.headline: Republican Craig re-elected in Idaho Senate race.

text.p: Idaho voters re-elected incumbent Republican Sen. Larry Craig over his Democratic challenger, wealthy businessman Walter Minnick, television networks projected Tuesday.

Craig continues the tradition in which the state has sent Republican senators to Washington since 1956. Craig had seemed sure of re-election, but late in the race Minnick charged the senator had been a weak defender against outsiders who wanted it to become a dumping ground for nuclear waste.
